name: Koi Saku Kagami
source:
Satsuki, who has stood out amongst her peers since she first started high school, is rumored to be the "Takamine no Sakura".
 
Kagami has had a crush on Satsuki for the last 3 years. Hoping to talk to her at least once before graduation, he tries to get up the courage to approach her, but...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7711]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
櫻月自高中入學以來就備受矚目，被人們稱為「高嶺之櫻」。

鏡水已經默默喜歡了櫻月三年。哪怕只有一次，他也想在畢業前與她說上話，於是鼓起勇氣，試著靠近她，然而……

[譯自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7711]NovelGame[/url]]
